# gtm_user_permission (Resource)

Manages a Google Tag Manager UserPermission object through API v2.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email_address` (String) User's email address.
- `parent` (String) Canonical API-relative path of the parent resource.

### Optional

- `account_access_json` (String, Sensitive) GTM Account access permissions.
- `container_access_json` (String, Sensitive) GTM Container access permissions.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) The Account ID uniquely identifies the GTM Account.
- `id` (String) Canonical API-relative resource path.
- `path` (String) Canonical API-relative resource path.
